id: title:VojtechBartos:let a person step off a report s reviewers

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend state and action definitions for removing a reviewer from a report, alongside a backend tool registration, though backend implementation and database migration are absent.
review.reason: The chunk adds frontend TypeScript actions and state properties related to leaving a review and a backend tool registration. While the backend implementation and database migration are not supplied, the frontend changes establish the necessary client-side behavior and the backend tool registration indicates an intended capability. This represents a substantive, bounded capability,
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of frontend and registration changes, but the absence of backend implementation and database migration prevents a higher tier. The actual correctness and completeness of the removal operation cannot be verified.
